# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are the search results provided; no other information was used.

## What changed

**Workforce and HR**
- Zepto moved its scheduled holiday to Monday from Tuesday, giving employees an extra day off after Diwali. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora said the aim was to give people "a longer weekend to celebrate." (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms), 8 Nov 2026

**Pay and benefits controversy**
- A viral video reported that a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of money as a Diwali bonus, which critics called "peanuts in the name of a bonus." (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html), 9 Nov 2026
- Commenters raised wider concerns about gig-economy working conditions. One social media post claimed a "Zepto valuation 7 billion," but this is an unverified user claim. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html), 9 Nov 2026

**Demand and product**
- Zepto reported strong festive demand, including delivering over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras. Industry reports say quick-commerce platforms saw sharp growth in high-value orders. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm), 8 Nov 2026

**Marketing and launches**
- Zepto entered a "Seoul Street" fandom campaign, with "Anime India" flagged as next. Zepto did not say which fandom comes next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta commented on the campaign. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago), 21 Oct 2026
- Fans were due to gather in Hyderabad on 14 November for a related event. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago), 21 Oct 2026

## Hires and deals

- **Hires:** No new hires were found in the window. Sneha Arora (CHRO) and Chandan Mendiratta (CBO) appear in the sources above but are not described as new.
- **Deals and funding:** No deals were found in the window. A company profile lists a venture round dated 1 July 2026 for USD 100M and a Series H dated 16 Nov 2025 for USD 450M. Both are outside the 30-day window and the profile is undated, so treat them as background only. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58), undated

## Gaps

- No sources were found on Zepto's executive changes, product launches beyond the campaign, or partnerships in the window.
- Results about the "zeptoverse" in physics are unrelated to the company and were excluded.

## Open questions

1. How is Zepto reviewing the Diwali bonus structure for delivery partners, including the use of coupons instead of cash, given the public criticism?
2. What is the timing and scope of the next fandom campaign after Seoul Street, and how is Zepto measuring its results?
3. What is the current funding and valuation position following the 2026 venture round, and what hiring is planned for HR and brand leadership?
